Lemma preselect_active (sp : bv 64) (values : list (bv 64))
 (Hlen : length values = 17%nat) :
 instr_lookup_resources Index.lookup -∗
 instr_body_lookup_resources Index.body_lookup -∗
 instr_pre 0x156e8 ("x2" ↦ᵣ RVal_Bits sp ∗
   (bv_unsigned sp + 1032) ↦ₘ∗ values) -∗
 instr_pre 0x156e8 ("x2" ↦ᵣ RVal_Bits sp ∗
   (bv_unsigned sp + 1032) ↦ₘ∗ values).
expected_behavior: The active preselector accepts the owned explicit handoff.
residual: The assertion checks one tactic and restores its input state. The proof then closes the owned handoff with iExact or iFrame. These hand statements implement a regression test. They do not repair a stalled machine proof.
